# Welcome to IB Biology

Welcome to this online textbook for IB Biology students.

This textbook is designed to help you understand biology,
connect biological concepts to real-world examples, and
prepare for assessments.

## How to use this textbook

Each chapter contains explanations, diagrams, examples,
and opportunities to test your understanding.

## Start learning

Our first topic is **Cell Biology**.
